description: Join requests. action=mine: your own requests and, for accepted ones, a fresh single-use invite (replaces any earlier unused one). action=list: pending requests to join the Space you are in. action=accept or decline with request_id: answer one; the requester is told in their own Space. Answering needs invite rights (project or full scope). list and mine are read-mostly; accept and decline are not idempotent.

request_id.description: accept or decline: the request id from action=list or the note posted in this Space.
